tasks.title: Implement queue, retry, resume and reconciliation

tasks.title: Implement content-addressed master ingestion

LEVEL_1_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.definition: Real provider generation plus provider-original bytes durably saved and strictly validated on the Windows VPS. Operator-controlled generation/download is allowed and must be truthfully classified.
LEVEL_1_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.does_not_prove: Zero-touch backend operation after job dispatch.

LEVEL_2_AUTONOMOUS_BACKEND_CANDIDACY.definition: A backend job/prompt is dispatched to an allowed provider transport and, with zero operator action after dispatch, completion is detected, provider-original bytes are acquired, strictly validated, content-addressed and durably saved locally with a typed receipt.
